name: Hack Battles! 💥
desc:
Activate powerful in-game hack abilities to knock enemies off an island in fast-paced sword PvP! ⚔️ 

⬇️⬇️⬇️⬇️⬇️

HOW TO PLAY:
😈 Equip one of our Hack abilities
💨 Launch into the battle island through the portal
⚔️ Battle other Hack users with your sword for Credits
🔥 Unlock even stronger Hacks with your Credits

PRO TIP:
When you hit another player, they are knocked back in the direction you're facing — turn toward the edge to send them into the void!

😱 Every few minutes a random event changes the island — bonus zones, danger areas, healing spots, double knockback fields, and more.

😊 New weapon skins appear every 24h and 12h, and hit effects rotate every 5 and 15 minutes — there’s always something new to check in for.

Your next Hack is waiting — jump in!
